messages:
Priya (docs): Quick syncI opened a PR to add a short "consent playbook" + auditor checklist for SOC2 exports. Want to be explicit about consent metadata, legal-hold behavior, and a tiny API example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2783

Hannah (security): Love this. Two security musts: list the default server-side redaction keys (ip_address, user_email, api_key, auth_token, location) and a clear sentence: 'Server-side redaction is authoritative; do not rely on client-side redaction.'

Vik (eng): I'll paste a compact curl example to request a redaction-first export vs full-export (enterprise). Using header X-Redwood-Export-Version: 2. Example (body flag): {"export_type":"redaction_first"} or {"export_type":"full_export","consent_id":"cons_..."}

Marco (legal): For any full_export we require a recorded consent ledger entry containing consent_id, consent_ts, requester_email, approval_ticket. Add note that consent must be retained per region-specific obligations and that legal-hold overrides configured retention.

Noah (devex): Add a one-liner Python snippet showing streaming download + SHA256 verify. People migrating from v1 want a concrete small example. Also call out header X-Redwood-Retention-Version if querying retention settings.

Priya (docs): I'll add both snippets. Also including a tiny JSON export-package metadata example with checksum, consent_id, legal_hold_id when present.

Hannah (security): Add integrity guidance: TLS in transit, AES-256 at rest, include sha256 in the export metadata and duplicate it in an audit index for cross-checking. Recommend keeping purge logs for proof of deletion.

Vik (eng): Implementation note for docs: exports staged to s3://redwood-exports/<tenant>/<export_id>/, presigned PUTs expire 24h. Purge worker soft-deletes (sets deleted_at) then final purge 30 days later. I'll give a sample purge log line for auditors.

Marco (legal): Also include a short retention-dispute workflow: customer requests extension -> legal reviews -> consent recorded -> retention rule applied. Show fields stored (consent_id, applied_by, applied_ts).

Priya (docs): Adding a small migration note: v1 used integer user_id; v2 represents actor as {"id":"user:u_123","type":"user"}. Will include a tiny diff snippet.

Noah (devex): Tiny UX nit: call the exported file an "export package" not "bundle" (matches glossary). Also add a mapping table v1->v2 for common fields in the SDK section.

Hannah (security): Final check: include a sentence telling auditors how to verify integrity after download: compute sha256 and compare to metadata, and verify the checksum entry exists in the audit index.

CI-bot: docs/pr-2783  linkcheck passed, tests OK :white_check_mark:

Priya (docs): Thanks all I'll fold these in and request final sign-off from Hannah + Marco before merging tomorrow morning. If no objections, will land at 09:00 PT. :shipit:
